                localStorage.setItem(key, value);
            }
        
            function getCookie(key) {
                return localStorage.getItem(key);
            }

            ]
            function switchLanguage(lang){
                // String Replace Part
                $.each(elementTranslates, function(key,tranItem) {
                    var changeText= tranItem.text[lang];
                    var selector=tranItem.selector;
                    if (tranItem.attr){
                        $(selector).attr(tranItem.attr, changeText)
                    }else if (tranItem.selector){
                        $(selector).text(changeText)
                    }
                });
                $('.languageSwitch span').removeClass('active');
                $('.languageSwitch span[lang='+lang+']').addClass('active');
 
                // Replace Element Part
                $('.trans-part').hide();
                $('.trans-part.label-'+lang).show();
            }
        </script>
